%% Do not edit after Phase 1 exits without circulating a change note.

\section*{Notation Sheet (Frozen 2026-04-20)}

\begin{tabular}{@{}lp{9cm}@{}}
\hline
\textbf{Symbol} & \textbf{Meaning} \\
\hline
$\mathcal{S}$              & State space of the absorbing Markov chain. \\
$\mathcal{S}_T$            & Transient states; $|\mathcal{S}_T|=m$. \\
$\oplus,\ominus$           & Absorbing states: success, failure. \\
$P\in\mathbb{R}^{(m+2)\times(m+2)}$ & Full transition matrix. \\
$Q\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times m}$        & Transient-to-transient block of $P$ (substochastic). \\
$R\in\mathbb{R}^{m\times 2}$        & Transient-to-absorbing block; $R=[R_\oplus\; R_\ominus]$. \\
$N=(I-Q)^{-1}$             & Fundamental matrix; exists iff $\rho(Q)<1$. \\
$e_i$                      & $i$-th standard basis vector (appropriate dimension). \\
$\mathbf{1}$               & All-ones vector. \\
$s_0\in\mathcal{S}_T$      & Initial state (or $\pi_0$ a distribution over $\mathcal{S}_T$). \\
$d\in\mathbb{N}_{\ge 0}$   & Horizon (number of steps). \\
$R(d)$                     & Trajectory reliability at horizon $d$ (Def.~2). \\
$R_\infty$                 & Asymptotic reliability $\lim_{d\to\infty}R(d)$ (Def.~3). \\
$k\in\mathbb{N}_{\ge 1}$   & Number of i.i.d.\ replications. \\
$\rho(A)$                  & Spectral radius of matrix $A$. \\
$\|A\|_\infty$             & Induced $\infty$-norm (max row sum of $|A|$). \\
$\varepsilon$              & Tool-error rate / perturbation magnitude. \\
$\Delta$                   & Perturbation direction matrix (Def.~4). \\
$\lambda$                  & Poisson rate in the NHPP limit (Thm.~5). \\
$\xi$                      & Latent correlation variable (Thm.~3$'$). \\
\hline
\end{tabular}

\paragraph{Conventions.}
(i) Row vectors left-multiply matrices; column vectors right-multiply.
(ii) $R_\oplus$ is the first column of $R$ (success column).
(iii) Where we write $e_{s_0}^\top$ without qualification, the dimension is $m$.
(iv) All matrices are real-valued unless otherwise stated.
